about.name: Coach Benji Buckles
about.title: HC
about.bio:
Coach Benji Buckles is a complete football mind with 4 years of experience on both sides of the ball at JR Toppers (Science Hill). A rare coaching profile, Benji brings depth with expertise in Wide Zone offensive systems and 4-2-5 defensive principles — giving athletes a holistic understanding of the game that most coaches simply can't offer.

Whether working with skill positions or defensive personnel, Coach Buckles brings an all-encompassing approach to player development that shows up on the scoreboard.

hero.headline: JR Toppers (Science Hill)'s Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized offensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: Complete Football Development
services.description: A full-game coaching program covering both offensive concepts (Wide Zone) and defensive principles (4-2-5). Perfect for athletes and coaches who want the complete picture.

services.title: Film Study & Game Planning
services.description: In-depth film breakdown on both sides of the ball — opponent tendencies, scheme adjustments, and game-week preparation.

services.title: Individual Skill Coaching
services.description: One-on-one sessions targeting your specific position needs, from technique to football IQ and mental reps.
